---
title: "Faceting"
description: "Small multiples — one panel per level of a grouping variable with facet_wrap()."
categories: [Composition]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

`facet_wrap()` splits the data into a panel per group, sharing scales so the
panels are directly comparable.

```{r}
p <- vplot(mtcars, width = 8, height = 3.4) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>
  facet_wrap(~cyl) |>
  labs(title = "Weight vs. mpg, faceted by cylinder count")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "facets")
```
